assets.name: Spikey
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE transparent PNG game sprite, restyling the FIRST reference sprite into exactly the spare flat arcade drawing style of the other THREE references. Keep the first sprite's role and characteristic silhouette, simplify aggressively. The other three are STYLE REFERENCES only, do not reproduce their silhouettes. Pure opaque BLACK body, thin clean continuous PALE pastel colored outline, at most 1 or 2 simple interior outline strokes. No shading, no gradients, no metallic material, no colored body fill, no texture, no bevels, no lighting, no bloom or fuzzy glow, no background, no text. Real transparent alpha outside the body. Black interior must be opaque, not transparent. Match the visual economy and line weight of the simple reference sprites: approximately 3px outlines when scaled to a 96px canvas. Square canvas, entire sprite centered, fills about 75 percent of canvas height/width with transparent margins; top-down, facing upward. Must read at 32px. Eight-pointed spiked mine: eight broad triangular spikes radiating from one compact black center. Pale straw-yellow outline. One continuous spiky outer contour, no central eye and no internal decoration.
